title: The Lame Beggar Healed, Peter's Sermon at Solomon's Portico

questions.question: At what gate of the temple was the lame man laid daily to ask for alms?
options: The gate called Beautiful
The Sheep Gate
The Water Gate
The Golden Gate
questions.explanation: Acts 3:2 (ESV): "...a man lame from birth was being carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple that is called the Beautiful Gate to ask alms..."

questions.question: When the lame man asked Peter and John for alms, what did Peter say he had instead of silver and gold?
options: "I have no silver and gold, but what I do have I give to you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, rise up and walk!"
"I have the Spirit of God which is worth more than all treasure."
"I have faith in the risen Lord which I freely share."
"I have the blessing of Israel's God upon your limbs."
questions.correctAnswer: "I have no silver and gold, but what I do have I give to you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, rise up and walk!"
questions.explanation: Acts 3:6 (ESV): "But Peter said, 'I have no silver and gold, but what I do have I give to you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, rise up and walk!'"

questions.question: After the man was healed and entered the temple, what was he doing?
options: Walking and leaping and praising God
Weeping with tears of gratitude
Shouting the name of Jesus loudly
Kneeling before Peter and John
questions.correctAnswer: Walking and leaping and praising God
questions.explanation: Acts 3:8 (ESV): "And leaping up, he stood and began to walk, and entered the temple with them, walking and leaping and praising God."

questions.question: Peter addressed the amazed crowd at Solomon's Portico: "The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, the God of our fathers, glorified his servant Jesus, whom you delivered over and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had decided to..."?
options: "release him."
"crucify him."
"flog him."
"imprison him."
questions.explanation: Acts 3:13 (ESV): "...whom you delivered over and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had decided to release him."

questions.question: Peter told the crowd they had killed the Author of life, but whom did God raise from the dead?
options: Jesus, of which they were witnesses
The righteous and holy one sent by God
His servant who was glorified
The one denied before Pilate
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus, of which they were witnesses
questions.explanation: Acts 3:15 (ESV): "and you killed the Author of life, whom God raised from the dead. To this we are witnesses."

questions.question: By what did Peter say the lame man was healed — not by his own power or piety?
options: By faith in the name of Jesus
By the power of the Holy Spirit given to believers
By the prayer of the apostles made in his behalf
By the grace of God working through His servants
questions.correctAnswer: By faith in the name of Jesus
questions.explanation: Acts 3:16 (ESV): "And his name—by faith in his name—has made this man strong whom you see and know..."

questions.question: Peter told the crowd he knew they acted in ignorance. What did he urge them to do?
options: Repent therefore, and turn back, that your sins may be blotted out
Weep and mourn for what they had done to Christ
Offer sacrifices at the temple for the sin of crucifying Jesus
Fast for forty days to atone for the death of the holy one
questions.correctAnswer: Repent therefore, and turn back, that your sins may be blotted out
questions.explanation: Acts 3:19 (ESV): "Repent therefore, and turn back, that your sins may be blotted out,"

questions.question: Peter said Moses declared: "The Lord God will raise up for you a prophet like me from your brothers. You shall listen to him in whatever he tells you." What happens to those who don't listen?
options: "Every soul who does not listen to that prophet shall be destroyed from the people."
"They shall be left without a covering on the day of judgment."
"They will be scattered to the four winds of the earth."
"Their names shall be removed from the book of life."
questions.correctAnswer: "Every soul who does not listen to that prophet shall be destroyed from the people."
questions.explanation: Acts 3:23 (ESV): "And it shall be that every soul who does not listen to that prophet shall be destroyed from the people."

questions.question: Peter said Jesus would remain in heaven until when?
options: The time for restoring all the things about which God spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets long ago
The day of judgment when God pours wrath on the wicked
Every knee has bowed and every tongue confessed him Lord
The last apostle has completed his mission to all nations
questions.correctAnswer: The time for restoring all the things about which God spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets long ago
questions.explanation: Acts 3:21 (ESV): "whom heaven must receive until the time for restoring all the things about which God spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets long ago."

questions.question: Peter called the crowd "sons of the prophets and of the covenant." What covenant specifically was he referring to?
options: The covenant God made with Abraham, saying "in your offspring shall all the families of the earth be blessed"
The Mosaic covenant given at Sinai with the Ten Commandments
The Davidic covenant promising a king from his line forever
The Noahic covenant sealed with a rainbow after the flood
questions.correctAnswer: The covenant God made with Abraham, saying "in your offspring shall all the families of the earth be blessed"
questions.explanation: Acts 3:25 (ESV): "...the covenant that God made with your fathers, saying to Abraham, 'And in your offspring shall all the families of the earth be blessed.'"

questions.question: The lame man who was healed had been lame from birth. How old was he?
options: More than forty years old
More than thirty years old
The text does not say his age here
About twenty-five years old
questions.explanation: Acts 4:22 (ESV): "For the man on whom this sign of healing was performed was more than forty years old." (This detail appears in chapter 4 but relates to the chapter 3 healing.)

questions.question: Peter denied the healing was done by his own power or godliness. He attributed it to the name of Jesus. How had faith in that name helped the man?
options: It made the man perfectly well in the presence of them all
It cast out the evil spirit causing his lameness
It restored feeling to his legs after years of numbness
It granted him wholeness because of his own prior repentance
questions.correctAnswer: It made the man perfectly well in the presence of them all
questions.explanation: Acts 3:16 (ESV): "...and the faith that is through Jesus has given the man this perfect health in the presence of you all."

questions.question: What did Peter call Jesus in Acts 3:14 that highlighted His innocence?
options: The Holy and Righteous One
The Lamb without blemish
The Spotless Servant of God
The Innocent One of Israel
questions.explanation: Acts 3:14 (ESV): "But you denied the Holy and Righteous One, and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,"

questions.question: Peter told the crowd that God "having raised up his servant, sent him to you first, to bless you by..."?
options: "turning every one of you from your wickedness."
"granting signs at the hands of his apostles."
"giving the Holy Spirit to all who repent."
"fulfilling all the words of the prophets."
questions.correctAnswer: "turning every one of you from your wickedness."
questions.explanation: Acts 3:26 (ESV): "God, having raised up his servant, sent him to you first, to bless you by turning every one of you from your wickedness."

questions.question: Which of the following prophets did Peter NOT mention by name in his sermon at Solomon's Portico?
options: Isaiah
Moses
Samuel
Abraham
questions.explanation: Acts 3:22-25 (ESV) references Moses (v.22), Samuel (v.24), and Abraham (v.25), but Isaiah is not specifically named in this sermon.

key_verse_text: But Peter said, "I have no silver and gold, but what I do have I give to you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, rise up and walk!"
